description: Full-fidelity alarm/event record flowing northbound from L2 SCADA. Alarms are operational facts, not personal telemetry — exempt from the §5 aggregate bucketing that applies to process waveforms. Per ADR-2606111000 §5 + §6.

valueMilli.description: process value at alarm in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

thresholdMilli.description: alarm threshold in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

interlockMirror.description: true when this alarm mirrors a hardwired L1S interlock state change (read-only visibility per ADR §3)
